title: microcos antidesmifolia var. hirsuta
intro: Microcos antidesmifolia var. hirsuta, commonly known as the hairy velvet oak, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Microcos antidesmifolia var. hirsuta include wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
